about: Experience Twisted Metal™ originally released on the PlayStation® console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
Big and tough, fast and deadly, or just plain crazy! 12 deadly machines in all! Stalk highways! Hunt suburbia! Take your pick. One just says you all over!
• Drive anywhere, anytime, in any direction!
• Onto sidewalks, off ramps, into pedestrians!
• Fire off machine guns, heat seeking missiles and more!
• Brake and swerve, fishtail around corners!
• Battle up to eight deadly cars at once!
• Compete in local split screen two-player mode!
• Battle in city streets, highways, downtown, suburbs, even rooftops of skyscrapers!
summary: Experience Twisted Metal™ originally released on the PlayStation® console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
